evals.prompt: How does AgentCore version management work on each `agentcore deploy`? Show how we roll out `Version 7` alongside `Version 6` using a `10% -> 50% -> 100%` weighted canary on our `prod` endpoint (since the `agentcore` CLI doesn't expose version/alias flags), what CloudWatch thresholds trigger an instant rollback, and which version can NEVER be deleted.
evals.expected_output: Explains that every `agentcore deploy` mints an immutable `AgentRuntimeVersion` retained indefinitely; because the CLI lacks version/routing commands, use `bedrock-agentcore-control` (`list-agent-runtime-versions`, `get-agent-runtime --qualifier <VERSION>`, `update-agent-runtime-endpoint` / alias routing shifting `10%` to `v7` / `90%` to `v6` -> `50%` -> `100%`), trigger instant pointer rollback to `v6` if `SystemErrorRate > 1%` or `ThrottleRate > 5%`, and **never** call `delete-agent-runtime-version` on a live version currently backing an endpoint.
expectations: Activates the agents-deploy skill

Explains immutable `AgentRuntimeVersion` minting and using `bedrock-agentcore-control` (`list-agent-runtime-versions`, endpoint/alias routing updates) for `10% -> 50% -> 100%` weighted canary traffic shifting
Specifies instant rollback triggers (`SystemErrorRate > 1%` or `ThrottleRate > 5%`) and warns never to delete the live version serving an active endpoint
